name: Reaction Diffusion
desc: A living Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion field simmering on a coarse grid, its feed and kill rates drifting through spots, mazes and mitosis over minutes, rendered as sumi ink bleed, bioluminescent neon membranes, quantized topographic contours or thermal false-color.

energy.doc: contrast / ink density / glow gain of the field-to-color mapping

scale.doc: display zoom — magnify a sub-region of the pattern

feed.doc: Gray-Scott feed rate (drifts per section on top)

kill.doc: Gray-Scott kill rate (drifts per section on top)

style.doc: field mapping: ink = warm sumi paper with ink pools + grain / neon = edge-lit bioluminescent membranes on black / topo = quantized iso-contour bands (abstract schematic map) / thermal = ironbow false-color heat ramp

act.doc: multi-minute program: flow = gentle feed/kill wander / bloom = pulsing growth surges / mitosis = locked dividing regime, cells perpetually split
